alt: L.A. County Children's Health Initiative profile screenshot on locator.lacounty.gov
summary: A screenshot of the L.A. County Services Locator portal (locator.lacounty.gov) on August 15, 2026, showing the Children's Health Initiative profile for L.A. Care. The county's own official service directory continues to anchor the organization's address to 1055 W. 7th St., Los Angeles, CA 90017.
